ops.text: The UT's own portal (https://py.gov.in/districts, 12 Nov 2026) says it has two districts, Puducherry and Karaikal, with Mahe and Yanam as administrative units run by Regional Administrators. They are kept as four here because each is a geographically separate enclave (Mahe inside Kerala, Yanam inside Andhra Pradesh): folding them into Puducherry would lose the address information without misfiling anything. Treat Mahe and Yanam as regions, not revenue districts.
